verdict.line: You lose if Aatrox lands his W (Infernal Chains) into a full Q rotation; you win almost every other fight, backed by a 53.2% win rate over 1748 games.

brief.thesis: Irelia's E (Flawless Duet) stuns and Marks Aatrox, which lets her chain Q (Bladesurge) for a free dash, heal, and reset if he dies or stays Marked. Aatrox's entire all-in depends on landing W (Infernal Chains) to drag her into range for his three-swing Q, so the matchup is decided by whose cooldown lands first, not raw stats.

theirWindow.when: his W and Deathbringer Stance are both up
theirWindow.what: Back off to max E range. If he drags you with Infernal Chains while his empowered auto is loaded, he can chain into a Q swing and a max-health heal in one trade.

yourWindow.when: his W (Infernal Chains) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Engage with Q (Bladesurge) once your passive is at max stacks. Without the drag he can't reposition you into his Q swings, so trade freely and follow with E for the stun.

start.why: Highest win rate start (53.6% over 1833 games) and the lane sustain to out-trade his early Q pokes before his W all-in comes online.

boots.why: 82.8% pick rate at 53.5% win — Aatrox's Q swings and autos are pure physical damage, and steelcaps directly cut the incoming auto/Q chip.

core.why: On-hit damage and the slow proc punish him for standing still to land Infernal Chains, and it feeds your Ionian Fervor stacking.
Highest-winning core path (60.3% over 287 games) once you're the ahead-of-schedule threat in the 9-13 spike window.
Converts his burst into damage-over-time you can heal through, directly answering his Q-into-W all-in pattern.

situational.when: you are ahead and want to end skirmishes before his Deathbringer Stance and Umbral Dash heals stabilize him (68.7% win path)
his Deathbringer Stance and Umbral Dash healing is keeping him alive through your combos

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through the extended trades this lane produces and converts to healing right as you reach the level 9-13 item spike where you want to force fights.

summoners.why: 92.3% pick rate at 54.2% win. Ignite punishes his lack of early sustain before Deathbringer Stance and Umbral Dash ramp up, and it secures kills off your E (Flawless Duet) stun.

playing.title: Track his W cooldown constantly
playing.detail: Infernal Chains is 20/18/16/14/12s. If it's down, he loses the drag that sets up his three-swing Q — that's your green light to engage.

playing.title: Charge W through his all-in
playing.detail: Defiant Dance deals more damage the longer it's charged and reduces the physical damage you take while charging — time it to eat his Q swings, not your own poke.

playing.title: Chain E into Q for the reset
playing.detail: Flawless Duet stuns and Marks him; follow immediately with Bladesurge since a Marked target refreshes the Q cooldown on hit.

playing.title: Only all-in at max passive stacks
playing.detail: Ionian Fervor's bonus damage only kicks in at full stacks — weave Q and E in poke range before committing to a full trade.

playing.title: Don't facetank Deathbringer Stance
playing.detail: His empowered auto heals off your max health. Break line of sight or juke the auto rather than trading through it.

playing.title: Force fights at your level 9-13 spike
playing.detail: Blade of The Ruined King online is where the matchup swings hardest in your favor — look for skirmishes here before his itemization catches up.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win rates are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (53.2% Irelia win rate over 1748 head-to-head games); the cooldown reads and trade-window calls are my own tactical judgment.

stats.opponentTip: Keep some distance to avoid being hit by Aatrox’s (Q)-(E) combo. Close in to engage combat with [Q] when Irelia has 4 stacks [P] prepared. Absorb Aatrox’s skill damage with a well-timed [W].
